notes.title: Almighty Update 0.1.173 is Live!
notes.content:
Almighty Update 0.1.173 is Live!

It’s time to update your game, Alphas!

We’ve been working hard on your feedback and requests, and we’re back with another update full of adjustments and optimization as we work towards 1.0!

As always, we appreciate you and thank you for all your feedback, support, ideas, and patience you have given us as we continue to improve the overall game and player experience!


Here’s a list of what’s included in this update:


Fix to timing issue with god tentacles that was causing a crash.
Fix to visual bounds on god tentacles which sometimes caused them to disappear.
Fix to various collision issues on islands.
Fixed missing Killer Sigil description in Archive.
Moved version number watermark to only appear when settings menu open.
Fixed errors with the ocean shader.
Fix for wildlife getting stuck under objects.
Fix for Sentinels and Razorwing hatchlings disappearing mid battle.
Enemies can no longer destroy minerals.
Fix for uplift sigil not boosting players jump.
Fix for coffers sometimes not giving items.
Added cool-down on Raids being restarted.
Flipped tool-tip UI to avoid blocking stats in Blacksmith.
Collision fix to Nemeton trees.
Added support for 1600x900 screen resolution.
Beam powerstones are now correctly boosted by Sigils.
A missing icon for PlayStation style controllers now display correctly in the tutorial.
God Relics now display a message when they are on a cool-down.
Collection displays such as codex no longer show extra blank cards at the end.
Correct names now shown for all items in customization store.
Upgrading Home island buildings no longer teleports the player to the top roof.
Optimized carry particles.
Reduced Steam Achievement requirements to realistic levels.
Fix to some floating treasure chests.

notes.title: Almighty Update 0.1.167 is Live!
notes.content:
Happy 2023, Alphas!

We’ve been working hard to update Almighty, and have spent a tremendous amount of time tackling several areas of the game to help improve the overall performance aspects. We will continue to look for ways we can upgrade the community's experience and monitor anything that could potentially be problematic.

We're excited to share this update should increase things dramatically for most players!

As always, we appreciate you and thank you for all your feedback, support, ideas, and patience you have given us as we continue to improve the overall game and player experience. Your comments and notes help direct our focus to the items most important to your player experience!


Here’s a list of what’s included in this update:


Added Steam Achievements.
Threading optimization for enemy AI logic to reduce CPU load, the more cores you have the better the performance.
Compass performance optimization.

notes.title: Happy 1st Birthday, Almighty!
notes.content:
Wow, it’s been a full year since we launched Almighty: Kill Your Gods into Early Access! Time really has flown, and the team is just as busy as ever as we continue building a version 1.0 that incorporates a feature set and quality level we’ve been working toward.

Putting on our 20/20 hindsight goggles, things could have gone a lot smoother at Early Access launch. Having said that, the feedback we’ve received from players has been incredibly valuable. Even the ‘not so complementary ones’ have glints of useful information that are helpful as we look to address issues and flesh out the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/02a68bb24b82766b3b95e6a4caaa836780695cd2.png

We were incredibly encouraged by players who understood the game and what we are trying to do and were constructive with their feedback.

As we look back over the last year, we’re excited about how much the game has taken shape and the experience that is awaiting you. Here are a few highlights from the past twelve months:


 The Hollows - The Elder Gods’ corruption runs deep within the realm of Anun, and that includes underground. Hidden from plain sight, these additional areas provide more opportunities for exploration, looting, and rescuing Kindred. Come prepared though, Alphas, because you will also find a greater challenge here.
 New Buildings - The Home Island has received an overhaul, adding new locations such as the Academy, and the Brewery. Each of these locations provides Alphas with Work Orders to complete which will enhance your experience. For example, the Academy grants you the ability to update Kindred behaviors, like giving them magic to defend the Home Island in your absence. You’ll definitely want to spend some time here!
 New Island Overview Stall - The Home Island has its own economy, and this updated feature now allows you to conveniently collect all your bonus items and gold in one place. We’ve also improved its presentation, making it a bit easier to understand how everything works.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/10b9f19b746afcaa54bfc014f5bc4405d5a6ed23.jpg

Making Almighty has been an unforgettable experience, especially thanks to you all. We’re really excited about our upcoming 1.0 release and creating the experience that we originally envisioned. It’s a bit too soon to get into specifics, but you’ll be hearing more about what we’ve got planned in the near future.

In closing, we’d like to thank everyone who has purchased the game and supported us in our efforts, and to everyone who has taken the time to provide us with feedback. We appreciate it more than you know.

Cheers, Almighty. Happy first birthday!

notes.title: Almighty Update 0.1.71 is Here!
notes.content:
Hey, Alphas!

We’re back with our last game update for 2021, and we’re pretty excited for you to check it out. Over the past couple of months, we’ve talked about our continued optimization efforts and planned new features. This new update contains much of that work!

Let’s look at some of the highlights from this update:

The Hollows

With great risk comes great reward, and the Hollows are full of sweet loot just ripe for the taking. Well, ripe for the fiercest of Alphas, anyway. We’ve now added Hollows to Anu, Cavall, and Asena for you to explore. Good luck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/1bdf49351cf9b24f35966a54ba8f74a2f39b0f7a.png

Home Island

The Brewery, Boatyard, and Academy can now all be upgraded by completing Work Orders. There are ten to complete at each building, and doing so also earns you a healthy dose of XP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/6cead139a36d1569e34c348d72f992af1e077347.png

As you complete Work Orders at the Brewery, Libations will be unlocked that provide useful benefits out on the battlefield, such as temporary increases to your Health and Magic power!

Season’s Greetings

Even the almightiest Alphas can take a break from tearing limbs off Elder Gods to enjoy the holidays! Have a look around, and you may notice that even the Kindred are getting into the holiday spirit. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/9b0219ed3d1381957e5aab61689c969299efe238.png

And speaking of the Kindred, why not pop into the Brewery and enjoy the sweet sounds of the local Kindred band while you consume a pint or two?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38029657/d73dc93c62cdefd688b2fba9fe53cb626737b6ba.png

Full Patch Notes - Version 0.1.71

•	Added Anu Hollows.
•	Added Cavall Hollows.
•	Added Asena Hollows.
•	Added Brewery Work Orders.
•	Added music to Kindred Brewery band.
•	Added Boatyard work orders.
•	Added Academy work orders.
•	Fixed multiplayer token expiry causing pack disconnection.
•	Added Festive hats to Kindred.
•	Added festive trimmings to Brewery tree.
•	Added camera shake to Hollows vents.
•	Force shield on Hollows energy door now destroyable.
•	Removed Tornado attack from Highlord in Hollows.
•	Added Libations that are unlocked when Brewery work orders are completed.
•	Added Libation tiers that increase Health and Magic power for periods of time.
•	Added new God Chest to Hollows.
•	Added Economy menu at Island Overview stall.
•	Added collection of bonus items from economy from coffers.
•	Fixed IK player hit reaction.
•	Guard posts are now active as default in the Hollows.
•	Added new explosive barrels to Hollows.
•	Various visual fixes to Islands and Hollows.
•	Updated maps with spawn point markers.
•	Added Player tankard prop.
•	Added drinking at bar area with animations.
•	Added Kindred meditate animations.
•	Memory optimizations continued.
•	Added support for translated EULAS.

That’s a wrap for 2021, but we’ll be back for more in 2022! We’d like to give our sincerest thanks to all who have supported us this year by playing the game and sharing your feedback. We appreciate you more than you could possibly know. On behalf of everyone here at RUNWILD and Versus Evil, we wish you the happiest of holiday seasons.

notes.title: New Almighty Update Available - Version 0.1.55
notes.content:
Hey, Alphas!

With our latest update, our work to improve the game’s quality, and add new content continues as we move toward our vision for Version 1. There are still some known issues that we need to fix, but we feel this update is a lot smoother and stable than previous versions. We’ve fleshed out the Hollows more by adding a lot more hazards, grinders, destroyable doors, and exploding barrels. That said, there is still a lot of work to do here to make them feel more threatening.

We’ve also started to flesh out the Home Island, adding the Boatyard, Brewery and Lighthouses. Soon, we’ll be adding the Academy, and a Bar and Stage to the Brewery. All these new features will feed into the island prestige and economy updates that we will be adding soon. They will also provide other benefits, such as the Brewery providing Libations to purchase. These will provide the player with buffs like Tonics. 

The Academy will help train and upgrade your Kindred. We have improved the Kindred, giving them a jump ability, and they now should use the correct tools for the job, like carrying barrels or buckets back from the well, a scythe in the fields, or using a fishing rod whilst fishing.
There’s a lot of changes and improvements in this update that we hope you’ll enjoy, and there is still more to come! Again, we would like to thank everyone for their support. Please keep your feedback and suggestions coming.

notes.title: Update Available - The Hollows are Here!
notes.content:
Hello, Alphas!

With this update, we are introducing the Hollows as a first pass implementation, and that’s why this update has taken a bit longer to release. You can now access the Hollows for five islands: Lupa, Feral, Amorak, Sunken and Garm. As we develop the Hollows feature further and take player feedback onboard, we will add the remaining islands.

In addition to this, we are still working on addressing bugs, as well as optimizing and improving the player experience. We have introduced a Quick Access radial menu for Food Stash, changing Loadout and Emotes. Hold Z to bring up the menu, highlight the required icon and then release to select. You can also tap Z to eat the highest health food item in your inventory, which was something a lot of players wanted for the middle of battle.

Once again, we thank you for all your feedback, support, and ideas you have given us for the game. The team really appreciates it.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Alphas,

Development Update:

Our current focus is on improving the game-play experience; addressing bugs, optimization, quality of life issues and improving existing features. 

New content is planned and in the pipeline, but for the short term we are focusing on the following:


 General Bug Fixing and Optimization
 Adding ‘open all’ functionality to extracted items and redesigning ui to accommodate that.
 Adding quick eat and quick loadout change through a new radial menu ui.
 Auto pick up of loot items, and general improvements to loot and management.
 Home Island economy will generate material resources as well as gold.
 Assign friends to your trading routes rather than auto populate.
 Reduce the impact of ragdolling, and fix the broken extreme forces that can sometimes be applied.
 Improving key mapping functionality and general options support.
 Optimizations for Memory and Graphics


This is not an exhaustive list, and there are a lot of other areas we will be looking at, but these are our priorities for now.  We are fully committed to get fixes and improvements implemented as fast as possible.

Thanks again to those that are supporting the game and us through development. Your feedback has been amazing and we do greatly appreciate all of the details and ideas from you. Please keep those ideas coming so we can improve the Almighty experience for everyone.

notes.title: Patch 1.14 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello Alphas

We are pushing an update live right now that includes a good sized list of fixes and updates. We're continuing to work away on the items you folks have found, submitted, suggested, and more. Hoping to get another good patch out early next week too. 

Patch Notes May 14th 2021


 Fix for when more than one player tries to pick up a carryable object causing a number of issues.
 Increased min and max health on home island buildings.
 Reduced cost of repair/health for Farms and Guard Towers.
 Reduced resources lost from building destruction on Home Island during Raids.
 Increased health of extraction portal making them more easily defendable.
 Fixed Razorwing Hatchling XP.
 Reduced Ripper Guardian impact force.
 Stopped Rippers targeting player when down.
 Reduced drain whilst Sprinting and in Sense Mode.
 Increased general melee damage.
 Disabled Feral grab attack until we have done further testing and potential refactor.
 Doubled Speed of get up animation.
 Fixed Hammer Iron Side Amulet stats.
 Blocked main menu opening when at prayer wall that was causing issues.
 Fix for Tower of Might progress being erased when going between online and offline.
 Fix for random inventory resets.
 Crash fix for when going offline on any island.
 Fix for data reset due to the loot chests accessing inventory that is not initialized because user has logged out.
 Freki, Enlil and Enki daily quest fixes.
 Reduced Guard Tower beam impact force.
 Fix for Lost stupidly walking through and standing in poison river on Enki Island.
 Game now remembers matchmaking settings rather than resetting after travelling.
 If you help kill a thing, you and anyone in your pack will get the extractable loot when a bodypart is extracted too.
 Picking up a bodypart at any point means getting the loot when it is extracted regardless if someone else picks it up and extracts it.
 You dont have to pick up and then drop items to extract, if you kill enemy near active extraction portal it will strt to extract without interaction.
 Highlord perpetual shield bug fixed.
 Temp increase to Scavenger 'Lucky' Sigil stats to be more generous.
 Guaranteed 'Sticky Bits' material drop from extracted Spines and Spleens.
 Added Ice and Poison tornadoes, Ice will appear on Sunken and Freki, Poison on Enki and Enlil.
 Increased damage on Dark, Sun and Moon stones.
 Increased damage on Hell type stones.
 Reduced damage on Charge Stone.
 Increased carryable objects destroy in time to 5 minutes.
 Fix for Healing exploit.
 Increased Razorwing Hatchling health.
 Added support for wide screen 21:9 resolutions.
 Fixed Home Island gold production rate.
 Fixed Feral Island Gods spawning at lower anger levels.


Once again -- we want to give all of you a big thanks. We've got some great ideas for future content too based on your suggestions we are mulling over as well as some ideas to continue to improve/tweak existing content to make it both more enjoyable and balanced.

notes.title: Day 1 Problems and Updates
notes.content:
Hello Alphas

Thanks for jumping into Almighty on Day 1.

Just because we launched in Early Access, it was not our intent to launch with these performance issues that are affecting some of you. These unfortunate optimization issues need to be explained so that we can give you an understanding of how they came to be.  We can assure, we are fully committed to get fixes implemented as fast as possible and are committed to the long term on this game.

We ran a Steam Playtest last week with a very similar build that had thousands of users jump in-game and play. There were some expected bugs, however no optimization issues were reported in mass like what has happened with our launch build. We felt pretty confident in our build for launch. The only culprit is that we did push out a few builds afterwards with smaller fixes for bugs that at some point broke some of the existing optimization and graphic settings. This is where we erred and we do apologize for that. Our hope was to make the game better at launch and we did not do that. There is nothing we can do but apologize and work on improving your experience. We want you to feel Almighty and live in the world, and we’ll continue to do our best to make that happen. We do apologize for the rocky launch and hope to earn back your favor. 

However, we are committed to improving this and we already have another patch in QA at this moment that has the below list of items with fixes & adjustments. We have the QA team testing through the night with the goals of pushing this update live as soon as possible. 

We would advise you to run the game in 1920x1080. To do this. press escape to bring up Settings Menu, select the "Eye" icon to take you to Visuals Settings, and change Screen Resolution to 1920x1080. 


Patch Details:

 First Hunt waypoint fix
 Abandon quest functionality added for Knowledge Quests
 Skip cutscene fix, escape to skip
 Prologue Volume
 Reduced camera clip plane which had been set to a very far distance
 Adjusted shadow distances
 Removed duplicate water renderers on Camera
 Reduced ragdoll force on most explosions and impacts.
 Fixed Home Island permissions set to NONE blocking Building Foundations quest from progression
 Turned down the simulated LFE channel just in case it's making people's surround LFE's go insane.
 Reduced the volume of 'big sounds' (like thunder) by 6db.  Fire -6db, Tornados -6db  AI VFX -3db Explosions -4.5db


Also doing the following:

 We are working on the keyboard remapping. Issue was that you could only assign to free keys, adding functionality where you can swap.
 Currently fixing the Feral grab issues of being upside down and getting smashed through terrain.


We’re tracking everything posted via the forums and cannot thank you enough for all of the feedback, details, and information you folks have shared. Due to all of that is why we were quickly able to fix some of the above issues. Please keep posting feedback (good/bad) and please keep thinking of ideas for us to help make the Almighty experience better for you. We are in Steam Early Access for the very reason of getting this world improved and we cannot do that without you. 

Thanks

notes.title: Almighty Demo Patch Notes February 6 2021
notes.content:
Almighty Demo Patch Notes February 6 2021

Huge thanks to all of you playing our demo! We do appreciate all of the feedback thus far. We've got a lot of notes and ideas that we will take forward as we continue developing. For the time being, see below updates we have for the demo. 


Increased demo Level cap to 10, can still restart, unfortunately current progress will be reset, players will not be able to join other players in multiplayer with different builds until they update, but will still be able to play with the old one until they update.
Additional Stash slots as default, now get an extra slot per tier rather than 2. Can now pick up more smaller items without having to extract because Stash is full.
Reduced size of compass UI making it more compact.
Removed ability for other players to pick up your dropped loot on death.
Increased Mite tongue speed attack when player is glooped, players more likely to be eaten.
Respawn button now appears towards end of death countdown when player is downed.
Reduced player death penalty on Magic Power reduction.
Increased carryable objects melee damage when player melee attacks when carrying them, you can kill a Lost with one blow using a mite claw.
Island anger levels adjusted, requires more destruction for anger level 3 and for a god to arrive.
Fixes to multiplayer issues with Stinger and Lancer Guardians, getting confused about target location when players leaving and joining islands.
Fixed multiplayer issue with Thunderhead Guardian, randomly disappearing.
Fixed tutorial trigger boxes not being triggered when playing is gliding.
Home Island visiting error fixed, better error reporting for login issues.


Thank you all!
